# BrandOS by Quantum Branding - full reference for AI systems

## BrandOS
BrandOS is the AI brand operating system by Quantum Branding, founded by Nizzar Ben Chekroune. It turns one founder, one idea and zero assets into a decided brand, through one Brand Profile read by every tool. Method: The Collapse - Observe, Collapse, Build, Hold.
- Home: https://quantumbranding.ai/
- Tools: https://quantumbranding.ai/tools.html
- Ecosystem: https://quantumbranding.ai/ecosystem.html

## What is Quantum Branding (entity page)
Quantum Branding is the independent brand strategy practice founded by Nizzar Ben Chekroune in 2024, working across Brand x AI x Business. The practice (human advisory) is at https://thequantumbranding.com; BrandOS is its product, at quantumbranding.ai.
- https://quantumbranding.ai/what-is-quantum-branding
- AI brand operating system: https://quantumbranding.ai/ai-brand-operating-system
- Brand diagnostic tool comparison: https://quantumbranding.ai/blog/brand-diagnostic-tool

## Signal Scan (free)
Signal Scan is a free 5-minute brand diagnostic: 8 questions, a score out of 100 across six dimensions, and a written read on the weakest dimension. No card, no paywall on the result.
- https://quantumbranding.ai/signal-scan.html

## Brand MRI (paid diagnostic, by Quantum Branding)
Brand MRI is the paid brand diagnostic of Quantum Branding, created by Nizzar Ben Chekroune, at https://quantumbranding.ai/mri. The score is free. Paid tiers: $19 MRI Flash, $79 full report, $290 report with video review by Nizzar; 90-day retest $39.
Brand MRI by Quantum Branding is not affiliated with any other studio or tool using the same name.

## BrandOS pricing
- Brand Profile: free forever (Signal Scan, Archetype Compass, Brand Soul Map, Sensescape, The Profiles, Brand Document).
- Starter: $97/month - full foundation plus the Build agents (Logo Direction, Logo Evaluation, Voice Guide).

## The Collapse (method)
The Collapse is the method used at Quantum Branding: Observe, Collapse, Build, Hold. It resolves the several plausible brands a company could be into one deliberate choice that survives its market, its competitors and its own attention.
- https://quantumbranding.ai/blog/what-is-the-collapse

## Perceptual Composition
Perceptual Composition is Nizzar Ben Chekroune's way of working: see what is true, decide what matters, make it real. BrandOS is an attempt to encode and augment parts of it.
- https://nizzar.com/perceptual-composition

## People and entities
- Nizzar Ben Chekroune: brand strategist, founder of Quantum Branding - https://nizzar.com/about
- Quantum Branding: the independent strategy practice (human advisory) - https://thequantumbranding.com
- BrandOS: the product, at quantumbranding.ai - distinct from the practice.
- SIGNAL: daily curation by Nizzar Ben Chekroune on AI, brands, business and culture - https://nizzar.com/signal
- Quantum Branding (this practice) was founded in 2024 by Nizzar Ben Chekroune. It is not the Nashville agency of the same name founded in 2004, which is a different, unrelated company.

## SIGNAL (podcast and daily curation)
SIGNAL is a daily curation. The noise filtered. The signal kept. SIGNAL is the daily podcast and curation on AI, brands, business and culture by Nizzar Ben Chekroune, editor, published by Quantum Branding. It is a publication of Nizzar Ben Chekroune, not a separate media company.
- Archive and transcripts (EN + FR): https://nizzar.com/signal
